states.meaning: Course exists in authoritative curriculum registry; no subject-specific extraction required yet.
Canonical source locations are registered and queryable.
A usable subject study prototype exists and may evolve.
Subject is actively prioritized because a near-term exam/use case needs it.
Core question/topic/answer structure is substantially validated.
A specific release is immutable; later changes require a new version.

rules: State does not transfer authority between subjects.
Exam priority changes work order, not source truth.
A frozen release remains preserved when a newer release is created.
